description: The first 10K fully animated Ordinal collection on Fractal Bitcoin. 10,000 unique pixel-art birds, inspired by the CC0 Moonbirds universe. In 2022, Moonbirds went CC0 — the birds flew free. Under a FULL MOON, they landed on Fractal Bitcoin. Fully animated. Fully on-chain. Forever. Their journey continues with FMBOX — a digital home for exploring, collecting and organising on-chain inscriptions. View any wallet, sort your treasures and let your birds fly free at fmbox.app.
name: FULL🦉MOONBIRDS
